```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(seed = 42)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(DoubletFinder)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 6000 * 1024^2)
#Creating the output folder in case it's not there

#     }
```




```{r DoubletFinder}
#Loading precreated file
# 
KA_seurat_prefiltered <- readRDS("../QC/KA_seurat_prefiltered.rds")

srat_QC <- subset(KA_seurat_prefiltered, subset = percent.mt<1 & nFeature_RNA>500)

srat_KA1 <- subset(srat_QC,subset=sample.origin=="KA1")
#Pre-process KA1 seurat object
srat_KA1 <- SCTransform(srat_KA1,verbose=F)
srat_KA1 <- RunPCA(srat_KA1, features = VariableFeatures(object = srat_KA1))
srat_KA1 <- FindNeighbors(srat_KA1, dims = 1:20)
srat_KA1 <- FindClusters(srat_KA1, resolution = 1)
srat_KA1 <- RunTSNE(srat_KA1)
srat_KA1 <- RunUMAP(srat_KA1, dims = 1:20)

#pK Identification
sweep.res.list_KA1 <- paramSweep(srat_KA1, PCs = 1:20, sct = T)
sweep.stats_KA1 <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list_KA1, GT = FALSE)
 
pK_KA1 <- sweep.stats_KA1 %>% filter(BCreal == max(BCreal)) %>% select(pK) 
pK_KA1<- as.numeric(as.character(pK_KA1[[1]]))
## Homotypic Doublet Proportion Estimate -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
homotypic.prop_KA1 <- modelHomotypic(srat_KA1$SCT_snn_res.1)           ## ex: annotations <- seu_kidney@meta.data$ClusteringResults
nExp_poi_KA1 <- round(0.016*nrow(srat_KA1@meta.data))  ## Assuming 3.5% doublet formation rate - tailor for your dataset
nExp_poi.adj_KA1 <- round(nExp_poi_KA1*(1-homotypic.prop_KA1))

## Run DoubletFinder with varying classification stringencies ----------------------------------------------------------------
srat_KA1 <- doubletFinder(srat_KA1, PCs = 1:20, pN = 0.25, pK = pK_KA1, nExp = nExp_poi_KA1, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = T)


saveRDS(srat_KA1,"srat_KA1.rds")
to_keep <- c(colnames(srat_KA1@meta.data),"UMAP_1","UMAP_2")
df_out<- FetchData(srat_KA1,to_keep) %>% rownames_to_column("cell")
out_name <- paste0("./KA1_",Sys.Date(),"_cell_metadata.tsv.gz")
write_csv(df_out,out_name)
```
